stages.mission1: Mission 1: the house in the woods

start.speaker: Scout
start.text: Is that it? Tell me that's the last one.

start.speaker: Fighter
start.text: That's the last one. Look at me. You hurt?

start.speaker: Scout
start.text: No. I don't think so. You?

start.speaker: Fighter
start.text: Not my blood. Get over to the fire. I want to know what we have left before it gets dark.

afterMove.speaker: Scout
afterMove.text: Three rounds. Three. And I'm not going to tell you about the food, because I've already counted twice.

afterMove.speaker: Fighter
afterMove.text: Then we stop shooting at things we can walk around.

afterMove.speaker: Fighter
afterMove.text: Don't turn too fast. One at the edge of camp, dragging its feet. I'll take this one.

afterKnife.speaker: Fighter
afterKnife.text: Close and quiet. It's the only way we can afford to do this now.

afterKnife.speaker: Scout
afterKnife.text: There's another one, past the creek. Too far for the knife. Damn it. I'm taking the shot.

afterGun.speaker: Scout
afterGun.text: Two left. And everything within a mile just heard that.

afterGun.speaker: Fighter
afterGun.text: Then let them come to us. Something's moving in the trees. Plant yourself, face the woods, and let it walk right into you.

afterHold.speaker: Fighter
afterHold.text: We can't stay here. A tent, a fire and nothing to eat. We're a dinner bell.

afterHold.speaker: Scout
afterHold.text: When I was up on the ridge I saw a house. North, through the trees. I didn't want to say anything until I was sure.

afterHold.speaker: Fighter
afterHold.text: Then we find out together. Stay low and stay close.

m01Win.speaker: Scout
m01Win.text: Clear. All of it. I keep waiting for one more to come out of the walls.

m01Win.speaker: Fighter
m01Win.text: Bring in everything from the crates. And look at the windows, the glass is gone. A door that won't close is just a hole.

m01Win.speaker: Scout
m01Win.text: A roof and four walls. Do you remember how long it's been?

m01Win.speaker: Fighter
m01Win.text: Don't get used to it. Fix the door.

base1Arrival.speaker: Scout
base1Arrival.text: Wait. Is that a pistol? You've had a pistol in your pack this whole time?

base1Arrival.speaker: Fighter
base1Arrival.text: Empty. Out there a shot meant company, so I kept it for a night I could afford to be loud.

base1Arrival.speaker: Fighter
base1Arrival.text: Four walls, and a door we're about to fix. One pile of rounds, two guns. Don't waste mine either.

herdWarning.speaker: Fighter
herdWarning.text: Stop. Everybody stop. Do you hear that?

herdWarning.speaker: Fighter
herdWarning.text: Exactly. The birds went quiet. Something big is moving in the north, and it isn't one or two.

herdWarning.speaker: Fighter
herdWarning.text: Two minutes. Maybe less. Seal whatever you can.

base1Win.speaker: Scout
base1Win.text: I think so. I think we actually did it.

base1Win.speaker: Fighter
base1Win.text: Sit down before you fall down.

base1Win.speaker: Scout
base1Win.text: We held. Against that. I never thought we would.

base1Win.speaker: Fighter
base1Win.text: Neither did I. Eat, sleep. Tomorrow we find out how far we are from anything alive.

warning.speaker: Fighter
warning.text: I'm not hungry. Eat yours first.

warning.speaker: Scout
warning.text: My legs are going. I need to eat something.
